summary: Accumulates the six components of two input 3D vectors (a2 and a3) into six consecutive double accumulator fields on this (this[172..177], i.e. this+0x560..0x588). a2's three components are added to the first accumulator triple (0x560/0x568/0x570) and a3's three components to the second triple (0x578/0x580/0x588). Unconditional, no branches; returns a3.

local_names.a2: first input vector (3 consecutive doubles); accumulated into this+0x560..0x570
local_names.a3: second input vector (3 consecutive doubles); accumulated into this+0x578..0x588; also the return value

operations.description: this[172] (this+0x560) += *a2: add the X component of vector a2 to the first accumulator field.
this[173] (this+0x568) += a2[1]: add the Y component of vector a2.
this[174] (this+0x570) += a2[2]: add the Z component of vector a2.
this[175] (this+0x578) += *a3: add the X component of vector a3 to the second accumulator field.
this[176] (this+0x580) += a3[1]: add the Y component of vector a3.
this[177] (this+0x588) += a3[2]: add the Z component of vector a3.
return result (a3): the function returns the second input vector pointer.
Invoked by AccumulateAngularImpulse (0043E5D0) to fold contact impulse components into the accumulator.

unresolved: Whether a2 and a3 are specifically linear vs angular impulse vectors is inferred from the caller name AccumulateAngularImpulse; the packet raw source shows only unconditional accumulation of two generic 3-vectors.
The six accumulator fields are assumed to be three consecutive doubles in each group (stride from double-indexing this[172..177]); contiguity is derived from the raw source, not separately evidenced.
The legacy ABI label 'Collision_Impulse_Accumulator' (abi:lead) uses an underscore spelling; proposed_name adopts the canonical identifier CollisionImpulseAccumulator.
